name: IM2A Relation
description: IM2A platform edition for OpenClaw: relation trust gating, paid-attention state machine, and three-state approval UI.

defaultTrustLevel.description: Default trust level for unknown senders (0=self .. 4=stranger).

minPriceCents.description: Minimum price (cents) a sender must offer to reach this user.

autoRejectAboveCents.description: Auto-reject offers >= this amount (anti price-harassment); 0 = disabled.

blockedSenders.description: Sender ids blocked from paid messages.

transportUrl.description: Optional IM2A core webhook base URL for outbound governance notifications.
